methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: SlotVTG introduces a lightweight slot adapter that decomposes visual tokens into abstract slots via slot attention and reconstructs the original sequence, where objectness priors from a self-supervised vision model encourage semantically coherent slot formation.
